articles.title: India and the next Kondratiev wave
articles.summary: The global economy experiences decisive transformations every few decades, marked by the emergence of new technologies, the decline of old industries, and shifts in economic leadership. Economist Nikolai Kondratiev described these significant, long-term economic cycles nearly a century ago. These recurring shifts underscore how innovation continually reshapes global economic power dynamics.

articles.title: ‘Sentimental Value’ Director Joachim Trier Rejoices As Global B.O. Surpasses $20M: “We Blew Off The Roof Again!”
articles.summary: Joachim Trier's awards season contender, 'Sentimental Value,' has achieved significant international box office success, surpassing $20 million globally. This strong performance positions the film to potentially outperform previous records set by movies like 'Kon-Tiki.' The achievement highlights the film's international appeal and its prominent standing in the ongoing awards season discussion.

articles.title: Trump’s Icebox: Has the President Gone MAD?
articles.summary: The article sharply criticizes Donald Trump's national security decisions, expressing strong disapproval of his leadership. It specifically questions the rationale behind a proposed $1.5 trillion defense budget, implying poor judgment and a lack of sound strategic thinking. The author conveys significant concern over Trump's overall handling of national security affairs, suggesting a problematic approach.

articles.summary: Showtimes for a new release or event are selling out within minutes, notes Joe Garel, CEO of Western Film Services. articles.title: Jenna Bush Hager Unveils New Role at NBC After 16 Years on Today
articles.summary: Jenna Bush Hager, co-host of "Today With Jenna & Sheinelle", is taking on a new role in the new year. She has announced she will be producing her first television show for NBC, described as a drama. This marks a significant move for Hager into content production, expanding beyond her on-air hosting duties for the well-known national network.

articles.title: India and Israel: A strategic partnership designed for the future
articles.summary: Malcolm Dash, who studied business and economics in Cape Town, South Africa, emigrated to Israel. He subsequently joined the Israel Defense Forces, undertaking combat service. This snippet introduces his background of international relocation and significant military commitment, likely setting the stage for a deeper narrative about his experiences within Israel's defence establishment.

articles.title: Trump undeterred in quest for Greenland after high-stakes White House meeting
articles.summary: A meeting between U.S. officials and the foreign ministers of Denmark and Greenland did little to deter President Trump's ambition to acquire Greenland. This proposition has caused significant diplomatic friction, with Denmark firmly stating Greenland is not for sale. The U.S. interest stems from Greenland's strategic importance in the Arctic, making it a key international geopolitical issue.
